lines.zh: 我走过林子，树顶都在动。
lines.en: I cross the woods, and the treetops stir.

lines.zh: 我每落一步，地面陷下去。
lines.en: Each step of mine sinks the ground.

lines.zh: 我的身体太大了，得绕开山。
lines.en: I'm too large; I go around the hill.
I walk slowly, and the clouds follow.

lines.zh: 我踩断了一棵老树，没在意。
lines.en: I snap an old tree and pay no mind.
I lower through cloud and keep walking.

lines.zh: 我走向那片有人的地方。
lines.en: I walk toward the place with people.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整片田地盖住。
lines.en: My shadow covers a whole field.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很远就能听见。
lines.en: My steps carry a long way.
I don't hide; I needn't.
I stand taller than the trees.
I raise a hand, and the clouds part a little.

lines.zh: 我在等，等那种悔意升起来。
lines.en: I wait for the regret to rise.
My chest is hollow and heavy.

lines.zh: 我的脸你看不清，我理解。
lines.en: You can't make out my face; I understand.

lines.zh: 我数着自己走了多少年。
lines.en: I count how many years I've walked.
Lightning gathers over me, then disperses.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看一小片村子。
lines.en: I lower my head at a small village.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾经也很小。
lines.en: I remember I was once small.
My fingers are wider than a door.
The grass dares not move at my feet.
When I breathe, the wind rises.
I set a hand on the ground, gently.

lines.zh: 我在听很远的地方的哭声。
lines.en: I listen to crying far away.
The sky stays pressed low.
Standing still doesn't tire me.
So small, and you dare look at me.
Your neck will ache, looking up.

lines.zh: 我记得你这样的人很多。
lines.en: I remember many like you.
You carry a smell: remorse.
My eyes are in the cloud, very bright.
Don't kneel; it means nothing.
I could cover you with one hand.
You're shaking; I watch.

lines.zh: 你走过来的路我都知道。
lines.en: I know every road you walked here.
I never quicken for anyone.
Your voice is too small here.
I lower my head to your eyes.
You can still walk; good.

lines.zh: 你的影子连我的脚趾都不到。
lines.en: Your shadow doesn't reach my toe.
I sway, and the clouds thin.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我腿上，很小。
lines.en: That hit my leg; it's tiny.
I lower my head and glance.
I step back, and the mountain moves.

lines.zh: 我没有叫，只是呼吸重了。
lines.en: I don't cry out; my breath only deepens.
The wound steams in the rain.
I press a hand to the wound.
This little pain buys you a bolt of lightning.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，雷乱了一瞬。
lines.en: I shudder, and the lightning falters.
I straighten and keep watching you.
That small remorse; it's fragrant.
Think it again, and I come closer.

lines.zh: 我要的是你心里的那点。
lines.en: I want the little bit inside you.
Raise your lamp; I don't mind.
The more afraid you are, the clearer it shows.
I lean a little your way.

lines.zh: 你退后的时候，味道更浓。
lines.en: When you back away, the smell grows stronger.
I reach out, and not to grab you.
Stay a while and let me smell it fully.
You hit my foot like a mountain.
I didn't yield, and you didn't back.
My fingers touch you, heavy.
I knock you into two rolls.

lines.zh: 我们相撞时，雷闪了一下。
lines.en: At our collision, lightning flashes.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你看的更硬。
lines.en: My body is harder than it looks.
You push my foot; I don't move.
I move my foot aside to let you pass.
You stand against my ankle.
People who touch me often freeze.

lines.zh: 另一个巨大的影子在远处。
lines.en: Another vast shadow in the distance.
We look at each other across the clouds.
Her lightning is whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并肩走，地面一起震。
lines.en: We walk abreast, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 我们不需要靠近也能说话。
lines.en: We can speak without drawing near.

lines.zh: 她走过的地方也陷下去。
lines.en: The ground sinks where she walks too.
Our shadows fold into one.

lines.zh: 她也记得自己曾经很小。
lines.en: She, too, remembers being small.
We wait for the same rain.
Two vast shadows walk slowly away.
I pinch up a tree and look at it.

lines.zh: 我拾起一座小房子的屋顶。
lines.en: I pick up a small house's roof.

lines.zh: 我把你的武器捡起来，很轻。
lines.en: I pick up your weapon; it's light.

lines.zh: 我抓起一块巨石，丢远了。
lines.en: I grab a boulder and throw it far.
I cup a cart in my palm.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根旗杆，插回去。
lines.en: I pick up a flagpole and set it back.
I pick up a bell and listen.
I right a whole field of wheat.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的帽子，放回你头上。
lines.en: I pick up your hat and put it back on.
I pick up a wreck and keep it.
That remorse in you is loud.
I've turned my head this way.
Clouds gather over me.
I know every step you took.
There's blood on you, faint.
I've chosen this place.
Lightning begins in my hand.
You looked up; let's begin.
I take one step toward you.
This needs no reason.
This sky is mine.
I've closed the road behind you.
Don't run; you won't get far.
I've started counting: one.

lines.zh: 你跑过田，田里的影子追着。
lines.en: You cross the field, and its shadow follows.
I raise a hand, and the clouds descend.
The lightning is looking for a place to land.
You hide in the woods; the trees are too short.
I hear your panting.
Step by step, the ground trembles.
You run east; east is mine too.
My hand opens above your head.
Lightning falls once, three paces from you.
You didn't stop, and neither did I.
I lower my head to watch you run.

lines.zh: 你的影子小得像一只虫。
lines.en: Your shadow is as small as a bug.
I set my foot ahead of you.
You retreat; perfect.

lines.zh: 雷在云里翻，等我的意思。
lines.en: The lightning churns, awaiting my word.
You look at the sky; the sky is mine.
I don't shout; a shout would startle you.
Fifty paces left.

lines.zh: 我一手盖下来，天都黑了。
lines.en: I bring a hand down, and the sky darkens.
Lightning falls along my fingers.

lines.zh: 我落下的脚，离你只一格。
lines.en: My foot lands one block from you.

lines.zh: 冲击把我脚下的土掀开。
lines.en: The impact tears the soil from under me.
One push, and you're thrown.

lines.zh: 我的手背扫过，风都变了向。
lines.en: My backhand sweeps, and the wind turns.

lines.zh: 雷落在我掌心，我丢出去。
lines.en: Lightning gathers in my palm; I cast it.
That was at a tenth of my weight.
The shock leaves your ears bleeding.

lines.zh: 我抓住一棵树，连根拔起。
lines.en: I take a tree and pull it up by the roots.
Lightning again, closer this time.

lines.zh: 我的手指按在地上，地裂了。
lines.en: My fingers press the ground, and it splits.
You pull back; I wait for you to steady.
This strike is for all that remorse.

lines.zh: 云从四边压过来，我站在中央。
lines.en: Clouds press in from all sides; I stand at the center.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，山矮了一截。
lines.en: When I land, the mountain is shorter.
The thunder sounds first, then I appear.
This sky goes dark all at once.
I come down out of the cloud, slowly.
Everyone on the ground looks up.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩平了一片林子。
lines.en: My feet flatten a patch of forest.

lines.zh: 雷云压下来，我踩着它落地。
lines.en: Storm clouds sink low and I step down on them.
I'm not here to save anyone.

lines.zh: 我把手放在云上，稳住自己。
lines.en: I rest a hand on the cloud to steady.
Lightning lights up behind me.

lines.zh: 这片地我走了很久才到。
lines.en: I walked a long way to reach this land.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看这么小的世界。
lines.en: I lower my head at a world so small.

lines.zh: 我的影子从山那头过来。
lines.en: My shadow comes from beyond the hill.

lines.zh: 我还没有决定要做什么。
lines.en: I haven't decided what to do yet.
I raise a hand, and lightning falls.
I straighten, my head into the cloud.

lines.zh: 很远的地方有人点了火。
lines.en: Someone lights a fire far away.

lines.zh: 火在我身上太小了，只烫了一处。
lines.en: The fire is so small on me; one spot burns.

lines.zh: 我从云里掉下来，砸出一个湖。
lines.en: I fall out of the cloud and make a lake.

lines.zh: 水只到我膝盖，却冷得刺骨。
lines.en: Water only reaches my knee, but it's bitter cold.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪掀动我的衣角。
lines.en: The blast lifts the hem of my robe.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我手上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my hand like a thorn.
A spell coils around my wrist.

lines.zh: 我很久没有吃过东西了。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in a very long time.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，云在上面越来越小。
lines.en: I fall, and the clouds shrink above me.
